name: Orderli
all_locations: Utrecht, UT, Netherlands; Amsterdam, NH, Netherlands
long_description:
Orderli is tableside ordering for bars and pubs in Europe. Orderli works without downloading an app, guests can scan a QR code on the table, browser the menu and order what they want. 

For the staff we provide a simple app which gives them a better overview who is ordering and control of the orders that are sent to the kitchen.

In the backend we use predictions to recommend restaurant owners what to purchase and make changes to the menu in real-time.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Dorus is the CEO and co-founder of Orderli. He has a degree in Strategic Product Design from Delft University of Technology and is a self-taught front-end developer.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Hi, I'm Maurits, one of the founders of Orderli. Before Orderli I did learned selling to people by selling lottery tickets near stations and selling cider to restaurants. At Orderli I handle the marketing, sales and support side. Love to learn new people and learn new things, so let's meet up!
